answer_1.js_fn: (() => { const D0 = input_1; const g1 = input_2 / 100; const N = input_3; const g2 = input_5 / 100; const r = input_6 / 100; let pvDividends = 0; let lastDividendHighGrowth = D0; for (let t = 1; t <= N; t++) { const Dt = D0 * Math.pow(1 + g1, t); pvDividends += Dt / Math.pow(1 + r, t); if (t === N) { lastDividendHighGrowth = Dt; } } const D_N_plus_1 = lastDividendHighGrowth * (1 + g2); const P_N = D_N_plus_1 / (r - g2); const pvTerminalValue = P_N / Math.pow(1 + r, N); const P0 = pvDividends + pvTerminalValue; return P0; })()
